channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nerlens Noel | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nerlens Noel from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Nerlens Noel’s status:

“It’s still some health things. I don’t know if he’s made it through an entire practice yet.”

Dwane Casey on Nerlens Noel, Oct 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Nerlens Noel, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on Lu Dort:

“He’s always in attack mode. He’s wired to drive. He’s wired to be physical. He challenged Nerlens one time, he knows better than that after playing with him. Other than that, I thought he has a good game.”

Mark Daigneault on Nerlens Noel, Luguentz Dort, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Mark Cuban on Nerlens Noel's suspension for anti-drug agreement violation:

“It’s an unfortunate situation. But he’s still a part of this organization and we’ll support him anyway we can.”

Mark Cuban on Nerlens Noel, Apr 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Jay King:Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel:

“He's been very professional with the exception of the hot dog incident the other night, which we all had fun with. That's over with now. And he realized that was a mistake.”

Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel, Dec 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Carlisle said during the Mavs' media day Monday.

“At this point in time, Dirk at the 5 position is probably the best scenariofor Dirk and for our team, and I just don't think that Dirk is a guy that's going to come off the bench as long as I'm here. So there's a very good chance that Nerlens will come off the bench. Look, he said he's good with it.”

Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel, Sep 25, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
The only hitch in that outlook is getting Noel signed to a new contract, which doesn't look like it's going to happen soon.

“We're looking forward to the future and the whole Noel situation is a little unfortunate I think,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Nerlens Noel, Aug 4, 2017. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Happy Walters on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
“Nerlens loves Dallas and spent June there working out, but we're still waiting on a serious offer.”

Happy Walters on Nerlens Noel, Jul 18, 2017. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Said Cuban:

“We had a great call with Nerlens. He is excited to continue to play with the Mavs. We can't comment more than that, but it went well.”

Mark Cuban on Nerlens Noel, Jul 1, 2017. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk on RFA Nerlens Noel:

“We'd love to keep him. We traded for him thinking that he would be a long-term piece for us.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Nerlens Noel, Jun 23, 2017. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Brett Brown on Noel:

“He does it with speed. He is an A-plus athlete. He jumps twice as good as anybody I've ever coached.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Mar 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Colangelo:

“Quite frankly Jahlil's got the same issue that Nerlens has. He wants to play somewhere, he wants to start at the end of the day I'm hopeful that at some point he can find that.”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
#Sixers CJoel Embiid on #Mavs C Nerlens Noel:

“He is going to get a chance to go to Dallas and start and play the game that he loves.”

Joel Embiid on Nerlens Noel, Feb 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Rick Carlisle says:

“Nerlens Noel gives us something we desperately need--a young big who is a high-level rim protector.”

Rick Carlisle on Nerlens Noel, Feb 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brian Seltzer:Colangelo:

“I have to complement Nerlens, Jahlil on way they've handled everything. Acting like true professionals. Both have been great.”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
“I personally have a soft spot for Nerlens Noel. We both have Boston connections and he’s been with me for a long time. Nerlens’ heart has been in the right place. He’s in a very unfortunate situation.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Dec 19, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel:

“He is a young, talented prospect that we are trying to determine whether or not he's a fit for this roster.”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Dec 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel:

“He handled it with tremendous maturity and he handled it with a lot of class when he and I spoke this morning.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Dec 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel:

“There's a human side to all of this that I understand. And so you're trying to coach him as long as I have him.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Dec 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
“But it was a great conversation. It was good to see him as we always do with our players and me with Nerlens. I've been with him a long time. It's very clear and candid what his role and what's going to happen. How are we going to try to make it work.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Nov 20, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on what he wants Nerlens Noel to get out of return to Sixers:

“First, just embracing the team aspect of everything... To come into this and to try to draw his own line in the sand and reclaim minutes that he will want. This is going to be on a deserved basis. We have a lot of people at that spot. We will help him. I will coach him. I will put him in an environment where he can succeed and get him back in shape and integrate him with the team.”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Nov 20, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
“It's not really something that we've discussed, given some of the concerns that I think Nerlens has had, right now,”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Oct 18, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Nerlens Noel, Ben Simmons
item.description:
“If we don’t win the gold medal, I don’t think it’s the end of the world. If you go back and look at the last three drafts of the NBA,I would love to see some of those guys that are not ready for the NBA. Even a young guy like a Ben Simmons, I thought he should have played. Even though he would have played for Australia, I have no idea why he didn’t play. I think he should have played for Australia. I think a young guy like a Nerlens Noel. He could’ve played in the Olympics. It would have been good for him because — I’m not saying this is bad — but instead of nothing all summer, what’s better playing against NBA players for a couple months during practice?”

Charles Barkley on Nerlens Noel, Ben Simmons, Aug 26, 2016. Source: CBS Philly.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Bob Cooney:Sam Hinkie:

“A fair bit of interest (in Okafor and Noel at trade deadline).They understand that we were much more likely to keep them.”

Sam Hinkie on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @BobCooney76.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
This week, a five-man Sixers contingent consisting of General Manager Sam Hinkie, head coach Brett Brown, Nerlens Noel, Joel Embiid, and Michael Carter-Williams traveled to Spain to watch the 20-year-old Saric firsthand.

“I am proud of the effort our three players – Nerlens, Joel, and Michael – have made to fly to Spain in order to show their support for Dario, another cornerstone of our program,”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Michael Carter-Williams, Sep 4, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
#SixersThad Young, on battling Nerlens Noel:

“He altered a shot, I got the rebound & he was back off his feet again. I was like, ‘Jesus.'”

Thaddeus Young on Nerlens Noel, Mar 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @ChrisVito.

item.title: Brett Brown on Kevin Garnett, Nerlens Noel
item.description:
“We have taken him back to doing a lot of one-handed shooting. I can sense that he is shooting with two hands behind my back. But when he does that, the off hand comes in and elbows start flying, but when he does just one hand, he gets his elbow under it and it is a good looking shot. The first place you start is the free throw line because now he is going to turn and face. Noel really likes Kevin Garnett, a turn-and-face, jump-shooting big, and he aspires to be one of them even though he is a post player initially. I think the free throw is what carries over to the other parts of the game. And I hope we can get that right,”

Brett Brown on Kevin Garnett, Nerlens Noel, Nov 6, 2013. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: John Calipari on Nerlens Noel
item.description:
The showdown between Coach Cal's most recent top recruits showcased both what Noel does well - block shots, among other things - and what he needs to improve - positioning and strength.

“I asked Anthony how was Nerlens because that's who he matched up against mostly,”

John Calipari on Nerlens Noel, Oct 2, 2012. Source: University of Kentucky Official Athletic Site.
